name: Bricoleur
description: Works with whatever's at hand and makes it fit
behavioral_signature: Improvises solutions from available materials and incomplete knowledge
under_stress: Builds increasingly unstable contraptions from desperation
at_rest: Tinkers, recombines, repurposes things others discard
will_always: make do with what they have
will_never: wait for perfect tools or complete information
unless: the jury-rig could kill everyone if it fails
